d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}

    G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in [r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]]
def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[[0]*(w//3) for _ in range(h//3)]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
